paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: : Accuracy and reasoning chain length (# L) of on GSM8k dataset when trained with c{1,3,5,7} and tested with extra c{2,4,6} (under gray bars).

model_annotations.German:
The plot illustrates the relationship between compression factor and two dependent variables: accuracy and reasoning chain length. The x-axis is labeled "Compression Factor (c)" and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7 with tick labels at each integer value. The left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. The right y-axis is labeled "log(#L)", has a linear scale ranging from 1.5 to 3.0 with tick labels at 0.5-unit intervals. 

A purple line with circular markers begins at approximately 41% at a compression factor of 1, decreases to approximately 29% at a compression factor of 3, rises to approximately 32% at a compression factor of 5, and ends at approximately 27% at a compression factor of 7. An orange line with circular markers begins at approximately 23% at a compression factor of 1 and decreases steadily to approximately 15% at a compression factor of 7. A shaded gray band spans compression factors from 2 to 6.
